name: David Durall
description: David Durall (b. 1970) is an American digital artist based in Herrin, Illinois. Known for his exploration of the intersection between traditional aesthetics and modern technology, Durall has gained recognition for his work in AI-integrated art and digital painting . His artistic approach focuses on "sharing beauty with the world" by leveraging artificial intelligence to create evocative, often ethereal imagery that resonates with classical sensibilities. He studied at Eastern Illinois University and Southern Illinois University Carbondale , building a foundation that allows him to bridge the gap between academic art principles and the evolving digital landscape.
